groups.title: 문장 구조와 동사 유형
cards: explain, suggest형 — 내용 + to 사람(4형식 불가)

give, send, show + **사람 + 물건** ○
explain, suggest + 내용 + **to 사람**
✗ explain **me** the rule / ✗ suggest **me** a plan
예) He explained the rule **to me**.
타동사는 전치사 없이, wait는 for와 함께

discuss, marry, reach + **목적어**
wait **for**, arrive **at**, listen **to**
✗ discuss **about** / ✗ marry **with** / ✗ reach **at**
예) We **discussed** the plan. , I waited **for** the bus.
부가의문문 — 꼬리는 주절의 주어, 동사에

꼬리 = 주절의 **주어 + 조동사**
긍정 → **부정** 꼬리 / 부정 → **긍정** 꼬리
✗ that절에 맞춘 꼬리 / ✗ never ~, **doesn't** he?
예) She **believes** that it will work, **doesn't she**?
간접의문문 — 의문사 + 주어 + 동사

know, wonder + 의문사 + **주어 + 동사**
**Where** do you think he is? (think류)
✗ why **is he** late / ✗ Do you think **where** he is?
예) I don't know where **he lives**.
2형식 보어 — 감각동사 + 형용사, remain + p.p.

look, sound, taste, feel + **형용사**
remain, stay + **p.p.**(당한 상태)
✗ tastes **deliciously** / ✗ remain **seating**
예) It sounds **great**. , Please remain **seated**.
목적격보어 — 사역은 원형, 나머지는 to

make, have, let + O + **원형**
get, allow, want + O + **to 원형**
✗ made me **to** laugh / ✗ got him **fix** it
예) She made me **laugh**. , They allowed us **to leave**.
막다 동사 — keep, prevent, stop A from -ing

keep, prevent, stop + A + **from -ing**
✗ prevented us **to go** / ✗ from **go**
예) The noise kept me **from sleeping**.
짝 전치사 — accuse A of B, blame A for B, regard A as B

accuse A **of** B, blame A **for** B
regard A **as** B
✗ accuse A **for** B / ✗ blame A **of** B / ✗ refer A as B
예) They accused him **of** lying.
수요, 이유, 필요 명사 + for

명사 demand, need, reason + **for**
동사 demand + **목적어**(for ×)
✗ the reason **of** / ✗ demanded **for** an apology
예) the reason **for** the delay
문장에는 본동사 하나 — 분사, to부정사는 서술어가 못 된다

주어 + (꾸밈말) + **본동사 하나**
✗ -ing, to로 끝나는 문장 / ✗ 접속사 없이 동사 둘
예) The man **standing** there **is** my boss.
It takes + 사람 + 시간 + to do

It takes + (**목적격**) + 시간 + **to 원형**
✗ It took **she** / ✗ two hours **for finishing**
예) It took **me** an hour **to finish**.
가목적어 it — make, find, think + it + 형용사 + to do

find, make, think + **it** + 형용사 + **to do**
✗ found **hard** to believe / ✗ found it hard **believe**
예) I found **it** hard **to believe**.
lie(눕다)와 lay(놓다)

lie(눕다) - **lay** - lain (목적어 ×)
lay(놓다) - **laid** - laid (목적어 ○)
✗ He **laid** on the sofa / ✗ She **lay** the box down
예) He **lay** on the sofa. , She **laid** the book down.
find(찾다)와 found(설립하다)

find(찾다) - **found** - found
found(세우다) - **founded** - founded
✗ The school was **found** / ✗ He **founded** his wallet
예) The school was **founded** by her grandfather.

groups.title: 시제
cards: 과거완료 had p.p. — 과거보다 더 먼저 일어난 일

과거 시점보다 먼저 → **had p.p.**
✗ When I arrived, the train **has left**
예) When I arrived, the train **had** already **left**.
현재완료 vs 과거 — since는 have p.p., ago는 과거

since, for the last → **have p.p.**
ago, yesterday, last → **과거**
✗ **have moved** ten years ago / ✗ When **have** you finished?
예) She **has worked** here **since** March.
시제 일치 — 주절이 과거면 that절도 과거로

주절 과거 → that절 **과거, would**
더 먼저 일어난 일 → **had p.p.**
✗ promised she **will** come / ✗ said she **sees** him the night before
예) She promised she **would** come.
시간, 조건 부사절은 현재가 미래를 대신

when, if, until + **현재** → 주절 **will**
know, wonder + if절 → **will** ○
✗ If it **will rain** / ✗ as soon as he **will arrive**
예) If it **rains** tomorrow, we **will** stay home.
상태동사는 진행형 불가 — belong, own, know, contain

belong, own, know, contain → **단순시제**
have(먹다), taste(맛보다) → **-ing** ○
✗ **is belonging** to / ✗ **am knowing** / ✗ **is having** a car
예) This bag **belongs** to me.

groups.title: 조동사와 당위의 that절
cards: 조동사 + have p.p. — 과거 추측, 후회

must, may, cannot + **have p.p.**(과거 추측)
should **have p.p.**(안 해서 후회)
✗ **must know** it yesterday / ✗ must **had** p.p.
예) It **must have rained** last night.
cannot ~ too — 아무리 ~해도 지나치지 않다

**cannot** + be + **too** + 형용사
✗ can be too careful(뜻 반대) / ✗ cannot be **very** careful
예) You **cannot** be **too** careful.
used to 원형, be used to -ing, be used to 원형

used to + **원형**(예전에 ~했다)
be used to + **-ing**(익숙하다)
✗ am used to **get** up / ✗ There used to **being**
예) I'm used to **waking** up early.
요구, 주장, 제안, 필요 that절 — (should) + 동사원형

요구, 제안 that + S + **(should) 원형**
✗ demanded that he **pays** / ✗ that we **not to** go
예) They demanded that it **be** fixed.
원형 짝 표현 — had better, would rather A than B, may as well A as B

had better, would rather + **원형**
would rather A than **B(원형)**
✗ had better **to go** / ✗ had **not better**
예) I'd rather **walk** than **wait**.

groups.title: 수동태
cards: 자동사는 수동 불가 — happen, occur, rise, appear

happen, occur, rise, appear → **능동만**
✗ **was happened** / ✗ **has been disappeared**
예) It **happened** last night.
목적어 없는 타동사 → be p.p.

타동사 뒤 목적어 없음 → **be p.p.**
✗ The meeting **will hold** / ✗ has not **discovered**
예) The meeting **will be held** on Friday.
능동형으로 수동 뜻 — sell, read, wash + well

사물 + sell, read, wash + **well**(능동)
✗ **is sold** well / ✗ reads **beautiful**
예) This book **sells well**.
4형식 수동 — 사람 + be given, offered + 물건

사람 + **be given** + 물건
물건 + be given + **to 사람**
✗ The students **were explained** the rules / ✗ offered **her**
예) I **was given** a book.
be asked, told, advised, allowed + to do

be asked, told, allowed + **to 원형**
✗ asked **turning** off / ✗ told **leave**
예) We **were told to leave**.
지각, 사역동사 수동 — be seen, made + to do

능동: see, make + O + **원형**
수동: be seen, made + **to 원형**
✗ was seen **enter** / ✗ was **let** to go
예) I **was made to wait**.
구동사 수동 — 전치사까지 한 덩어리(be laughed at by)

be laughed **at**, taken care **of** + by
✗ was laughed **by** / ✗ was taken care **by**
예) He was laughed **at by** everyone.
be concerned with(관련되다), about(걱정하다)

be concerned **with**(관련), **about**(걱정)
✗ 관련 뜻에 about / ✗ 동사 자리에 **be** 빠뜨림
예) I'm concerned **about** you.
목적어가 당하면 p.p. — have, keep + O + p.p. , let + O + be p.p. , want + O + to be p.p.

have + O + **p.p.**, let + O + **be p.p.**
want + O + **to be p.p.**
✗ had my car **repair** / ✗ wants it **be** changed
예) I had my hair **cut**.

groups.title: 수일치와 대명사
cards: the number of + 단수동사, a number of + 복수동사

**The** number of + 복수명사 + **단수동사**
**A** number of + 복수명사 + **복수동사**
✗ The number of students **are** / ✗ A number of problems **has**
예) The number of cars **is** rising.
부분 표현 of + 명사 — of 뒤 명사가 동사를 정한다

부분 + of + **명사** → 동사는 그 명사 수
✗ Some of the milk **have** / ✗ percent of the voters **supports**
예) Half of the cake **is** gone. , Half of the apples **are** gone.
one of the 복수명사 + 단수동사 — 뽑힌 하나에 맞춘다

One, Each of the + **복수명사** + **단수동사**
✗ One of the paintings **were** / ✗ One of my **cousin**
예) One of my **friends is** a nurse.
There + be + 주어 — 뒤에 오는 주어에 수일치

There + be + **주어** → 동사는 뒤 주어에
✗ There **is** many people / ✗ There **seem** to be a leak
예) There **are** two cats.
긴 수식어 뒤 진짜 주어 — 수와 태를 함께

주어 + (수식어) + 동사 → **괄호 빼고** 수, 태
✗ The quality of the products **are** / ✗ **have discovered**(→ have been)
예) The keys to the car **are** missing.
동명사, to부정사 주어 + 단수동사 — 동사원형 주어 ×

**-ing, To 원형** 주어 + **단수동사**
✗ **Learn** a language takes / ✗ Taking photos **are**
예) **Reading** books **is** fun.
the + 형용사 = ~한 사람들 → 복수동사

the + 형용사 = 사람들 → **복수동사**
✗ The homeless **needs** / ✗ the **olds**
예) The rich **are** not always happy.
재귀대명사 — 주어와 같은 대상이면 -self, 수를 맞춘다

주어 = 목적어 → **-self**(복수 **-selves**)
✗ The birds feed **itself** / ✗ He blamed **him**(자기)
예) They enjoyed **themselves**.
대명사 수일치 — its, their / that, those

단수 **it, its, that** / 복수 **they, their, those**
✗ Elephants use **its** trunks
예) Whales feed **their** young.

groups.title: 준동사(to부정사와 동명사)
cards: -ing만 받는 동사 — mind, enjoy, avoid, finish, deny + -ing

mind, enjoy, avoid, finish, deny + **-ing**
✗ avoided **to make** / ✗ postponed **to launch**
예) Do you mind **waiting**?
remember, forget, regret, stop — to는 앞으로, -ing는 이미

remember, forget **to** 할 일 / **-ing** 한 일
stop **-ing**(그만두다) / stop **to**(~하려고)
✗ forget **taking** it tomorrow / ✗ regret **to tell** her last week
예) **Remember to call** me tomorrow.
완료형 준동사 — 본동사보다 앞선 때는 have p.p.

먼저 일 → **to have p.p., having p.p.**
✗ is said **to be built** 500 years ago / ✗ **having been happened**
예) He seems **to have left**.
동명사의 수동 being p.p.

동명사가 당하면 **being p.p.**
✗ hate **criticizing** by the boss / ✗ afraid of **punishing**
예) He left without **being noticed**.
need, require + -ing = 수동 뜻(need to be p.p.)

사물 + need + **-ing** = need + **to be p.p.**
✗ need **being** p.p. , ✗ 사물 + need **to 원형**
예) My car needs **washing**. = My car needs **to be washed**.
준동사의 부정 — not은 to, -ing 바로 앞

**not** + to 원형, **not** + -ing
✗ told us **don't** run, ✗ promised **to don't** tell
예) I decided **not to go**.
의미상 주어 — 사람 성격이면 of, 그 밖에는 for

성격 평가(kind, rude) + **of** 사람 + to
일의 성질(easy, hard) + **for** 사람 + to
✗ careless **for** you / ✗ important **of** drivers
예) It's kind **of you** to help.
명사를 꾸미는 to부정사 끝의 전치사

live in a house → a house to live **in**
✗ no friends to **talk** / ✗ a house to **live**
예) a pen to write **with**
too ~ to, so ~ that S can't, 형용사 + enough to

**too** ~ to = **so** ~ that S can't
형용사 + **enough** + to
✗ **so** hot **to** eat / ✗ **enough old** / ✗ to lift **it**
예) He is old **enough** to drive.
결과의 to부정사 — only to, never to, grow up to

~, **only to** + 원형 (결국 ~하고 말았다)
~, **never to** + 원형 (다시는 못 ~)
✗ only to **found** / ✗ grew up to **becoming**
예) He left home, **never to return**.
be worth -ing — ~할 가치가 있다

be worth + **-ing**(수동 뜻)
✗ worth **to see** / ✗ worth **taken** / ✗ worth **listening**(→ to)
예) This museum is worth **visiting**.
cannot help -ing = cannot but 원형 = cannot help but 원형

cannot help **-ing** = cannot but **원형**
✗ help but **smiling** / ✗ couldn't help **cry**
예) I couldn't help **laughing**.
난이형용사 easy, hard, difficult, convenient — 사람 주어 ×

It is easy, hard + (for 사람) + **to do**
✗ **I am** difficult to ~ / ✗ easy to read **it**
예) **It is** difficult **for me** to understand the rules.

groups.title: 분사
cards: 감정분사 — 감정을 주면 -ing, 느끼면 p.p.

감정을 주면 **-ing**, 느끼면 **p.p.**
✗ The news was **shocked** / ✗ We were **surprising**
예) The movie was **boring**. , I was **bored**.
명사 뒤 분사 — 하면 -ing, 되면 p.p.

명사가 하면 **-ing**, 당하면 **p.p.**
✗ a letter **writing** in Latin / ✗ Students **wished** to apply
예) a car **made** in Korea
분사구문의 태 — 주절 주어가 하면 -ing, 당하면 p.p.

주절 주어가 하면 **-ing**, 당하면 **p.p.**
✗ **Writing** in simple English, the novel ~ / ✗ **Locating** near
예) **Seen** from above, it looks small.
독립분사구문 — 주어가 다르면 앞에 적는다

주어가 다르면 **주어 + 분사** ~, S + V
✗ **Being** a holiday, ~ / ✗ **Being** no seats, ~
예) **It being** Sunday, the shops were closed.
with + 목적어 + 분사 — ~한 채로

with + O + **-ing**(하는 채로) / **p.p.**(된 채로)
✗ with his legs **crossing** / ✗ with the exam **is** over
예) He sat with his arms **folded**.
접속사 + 분사구문 — while -ing, when p.p. , if used

접속사 + **-ing**(하면) / **p.p.**(당하면)
✗ **When asking**(질문받음) / ✗ While **drove** / ✗ **during** taking
예) **When asked** about it, he refused to answer.

groups.title: 명사, 관사, 수량
cards: 셀 수 없는 명사 — information, advice, furniture에 -s ×

information, advice → **-s, a, many ×**
✗ many **advices** / ✗ **an** information / ✗ The news **are**
예) **a piece of** advice, **much** information
such, so 어순 — such a 형용사 명사 / so 형용사 a 명사

**such a** + 형용사 + 명사
**so** + 형용사 + **a** + 명사
✗ **a such** / ✗ **so a** hot day / ✗ **such** difficult(명사 없음)
예) It was **such a** hot day. = It was **so** hot **a** day.
동사 + 사람 + 전치사 + the + 신체 부위

catch + 사람 + **by the** arm
pat + 사람 + **on the** shoulder
✗ caught him by **arm** / ✗ patted her **by** the shoulder
예) She caught me **by the arm**.
by + 교통, 통신 수단은 관사 없이 — by bus, by email

**by** + 수단 이름만 (by bus, by email)
관사, 소유격 있으면 **in, on**
✗ by **the** train / ✗ by **my** car / ✗ **by** foot
예) I go to work **by bus**. , He came **in his car**.
every + 기수 + 복수, every + 서수(other) + 단수

every + **기수** + **복수**명사
every + **서수, other** + **단수**명사
✗ every two **year** / ✗ every other **weeks** / ✗ every **a** few
예) every three **days** = every **third day**
one, another, the other, others, the others

둘: one ~, **the other**
셋 이상: one ~, **another** / some ~, **others**
✗ (둘 중) one ~, **another** / ✗ **another** books
예) One is red, and **the other** is blue.
수사 + hundred(단수), hundreds of(막연한 수)

숫자 + **hundred**(-s ×) + 명사
**hundreds of** + 복수명사(막연한 수)
✗ five **thousands** runners / ✗ **hundreds** people
예) **three thousand** people, **thousands of** stars
수사-단위 복합형용사는 단수 — a ten-year-old boy

a **ten-year-old** boy (하이픈 → 단수)
She is ten **years** old. (보어 → 복수)
✗ a three-**days** trip / ✗ She is **ten-year-old**.
예) a **five-day** trip

groups.title: 형용사와 부사
cards: 꾸미면 부사 — 동사, 형용사, 분사를 꾸미는 말은 -ly

동사, 형용사, 분사를 꾸미면 **-ly**
✗ **surprising** long / ✗ written so **careless**
예) The movie was **surprisingly** long.
almost(부사) vs most(대부분의)

**almost all** + 명사, **most** + 명사
**most of the** + 명사
✗ **Almost** students / ✗ Most of **students**
예) **Most** students passed. = **Almost all** students passed.
enough 위치 — 형용사 + enough / enough + 명사

형용사, 부사 + **enough** / **enough** + 명사
✗ **enough old** / ✗ not **enough warm**
예) He is old **enough** to drive. , We have **enough** time.
모양이 비슷한 부사 — hard/hardly, late/lately, high/highly, near/nearly

hard 열심히, **hardly** 거의 ~않다
late 늦게, **lately** 최근에
✗ studied **hardly**(열심히 뜻) / ✗ arrived **lately** / ✗ flew **highly**
예) He studied **hard**. , I can **hardly** see.
부정어 겹치기 금지 — hardly, scarcely, seldom + not ×

hardly, seldom + **any, ever** (not ×)
✗ **couldn't hardly**, ✗ scarcely **no** milk
예) I could **hardly** breathe.

groups.title: 비교
cards: 비교급 강조 — much, far, even, still (very ×)

**much, far, even, still** + 비교급 (very ×)
✗ **very** cheaper / ✗ **more much** useful
예) This is **much** cheaper.
짝 맞추기 — as ~ as / 비교급 ~ than

**as** + 원급 + **as**, 비교급 + **than**
✗ not as tiring **than** / ✗ more convenient **as**
예) This bridge is **as** long **as** that one.
한 대상의 두 성질 비교 — more A than B

같은 대상 두 성질: **more** A **than** B
✗ **kinder** than strict / ✗ **sadder** than angry
예) She was **more sad than** angry.
배수사 + as 원급 as — twice as ~ as

배수 + **as** 원급 **as** (twice as big as)
✗ **as twice** big as / ✗ twice as **bigger** as
예) It is **twice as big as** mine.
라틴어 비교 — superior, inferior, senior, junior, prior, preferable + to

superior, senior, prior + **to** (than ×)
prefer A **to** B
✗ superior **than** / ✗ **more** superior / ✗ prefer tea **than** coffee
예) This model is **superior to** the old one.
The 비교급 S V, the 비교급 S V — ~할수록 더

**The** 비교급 S V, **the** 비교급 S V
✗ The more **you are careful** / ✗ **more** people will come
예) **The more** you practice, **the better** you get.
최상급의 the — 명사 앞은 the, 한 대상 안의 비교는 없어도 된다

여럿 중 최고 → **the** + 최상급
한 대상의 때, 곳 → the 없이도 ○
✗ **highest** mountain(the 빠짐) / ✗ **the most tallest**
예) It is **the tallest** building in the city.
최상급 뜻 — No other + 단수명사 + 비교급 than, than any other + 단수명사

**No other** + 단수 + 비교급 than A
A + 비교급 + than **any other + 단수**
✗ as crowded **than** / ✗ **Any other** ~ bigger(뜻 반대)
예) **No other** city is bigger than Seoul.
비교대상 병렬 — to는 to와, -ing는 -ing와

to A than **(to)** B
**-ing** A ~ than **-ing** B
✗ Saving is harder than **to earn** / ✗ to wait than **going**
예) **Walking** is better than **driving**.
비교대상 맞추기 — that of, those of, 소유대명사

단수 반복 → **that of** / 복수 → **those of**
사람의 것 → **his, yours, my brother's**
✗ larger than **Seoul** / ✗ longer than **that** of a cat
예) The population of Tokyo is larger than **that of** Seoul.
비교 구문의 대동사 — be는 be, 조동사는 조동사, 일반동사는 do

be → **be** / can → **can** / 일반동사 → **do**
✗ taller than her brother **does** / ✗ works harder than they **are**
예) He runs faster than I **do**.
A no more B than C — C가 아니듯 A도 아니다

A is **no more** B than C **is**
= A is **not** B **any more** than C is
✗ than a horse **isn't**, ✗ A whale **is** a fish any more than
예) A whale is **no more** a fish than a horse **is**.

groups.title: 도치와 부정
cards: 부정어 문두 도치 — Never, Hardly, Not until + 조동사 + 주어

부정어 맨 앞 + **조동사 + 주어**
No sooner **had** S p.p. **than** ~
✗ Hardly **the teacher had** left / ✗ No sooner ~ **when**
예) **Never have I** seen it.
So + 형용사 + 동사 + 주어 + that / Such + be + 주어 + that

**So** + 형용사 + **be + 주어** + that
**Such** + be + 주어 + that
✗ So loud **the music was** / ✗ **Such** beautiful was / ✗ dark **were** the room
예) **So loud was the music** that I couldn't sleep.
부분부정 vs 전체부정

not + all, always = **다는 아니다**(부분)
never, none, neither = **전혀 아니다**(전체)
✗ ‘결코’를 **not always**로 / ✗ ‘둘 다 아님’을 **not both**로
예) **Not all** birds can fly.

groups.title: Day 5 / 접속사, 명사절, 부사절
cards: 등위접속사 병렬 — and, or로 이은 말은 같은 품사, 형태

A and, or, but B → **같은 품사, 같은 형태**
✗ to swim and **running** / ✗ quickly and **careful**
예) She likes swimming and **running**.
상관접속사 짝 — either or, neither nor, both and, not only but also

**either A or B**, **neither A nor B**, **both A and B**, **not only A but (also) B**
✗ neither A **or** B / ✗ both A **as well as** B
예) Neither the manager **nor** the staff knew it.
명사절 that vs what — 뒤가 완전하면 that, 빠진 자리가 있으면 what

뒤가 완전한 절 → **that** / 뒤에 빠진 자리 → **what**
✗ I believe **what** he is honest / ✗ **That** she said was true
예) **What** she said was true. / **That** he lied is clear.
주어, 전치사의 목적어 자리 명사절은 whether(if 불가)

주어 자리, 전치사 뒤 명사절 → **whether** (if ×)
✗ **If** she comes is unclear / ✗ about **if** I should go
예) **Whether** she comes is unclear.
A is to B what C is to D

**A is to B what C is to D** (A와 B의 관계 = C와 D의 관계)
✗ A is **for** B what ~ / ✗ A is to B **that** C is to D
예) Reading is to the mind **what** exercise is to the body.
전치사 + 명사구 vs 접속사 + 절(because of ↔ because)

전치사 **because of, despite, during** + 명사구 / 접속사 **because, although, while** + 절
✗ **because of** he was late / ✗ **despite** it rained
예) We stayed in **because of** the rain. = **because** it rained.
lest S (should) 원형 — not 중복 금지

**lest + S + (should) 원형** — lest 자체가 “~하지 않도록”
✗ lest he **should not** forget / ✗ lest he **forgets**
예) Write it down **lest** you (should) **forget**.
양보구문 — (As) 보어, 명사, 부사 + as[though] + S + V

**형용사, 무관사 명사, 부사 + as[though] + S + V** (비록 ~이지만)
✗ **A child** as he was / ✗ Tired as **was he**
예) **Child as** he was, he was brave. / **Tired as** she was, she kept working.
However, No matter how + 형용사/부사 + S + V 어순

**However, No matter how + 형용사/부사 + S + V**
✗ However **you try hard** / ✗ However **it is difficult**
예) **However hard** you try, you can't finish it today.

groups.title: Day 5 / 관계사
cards: 관계대명사의 격 — 뒤 절에서 빠진 자리로 정한다(whose 포함)

주어 빠짐 → **who, which** / 목적어 빠짐 → **whom, which** / 뒤 명사의 주인 → **whose**
✗ the man **whom** lives next door / ✗ the girl **who** father is a doctor
예) the boy **whose** bike was stolen
콤마 뒤 계속적 용법에는 that 불가, 앞 문장 전체를 받는 which

콤마 뒤 → **, which / , who** (that ×) / 앞 문장 전체 → **, which**
✗ my car, **that** is old / ✗ He passed, **what** surprised me
예) He passed the test, **which** surprised everyone.
선행사 all, everything, 최상급 → that / 선행사가 없으면 what

all, everything, the only, 최상급 + **that** / 선행사 없음 → **what**
✗ everything **what** I have / ✗ the thing **what** I want
예) This is all **that** I have. / This is **what** I want.
관계부사 where, when, why, how — 뒤 절이 완전, 전치사 + which

**where, when, why, how** + 완전한 절 = **전치사 + which**
✗ the city **where** I visited (목적어 빠짐 → which) / ✗ **the way how**
예) the house **where** I was born = the house **in which** I was born
복합관계대명사의 격은 자기 절 안의 역할로(whoever ↔ whomever)

자기 절에서 주어 → **whoever** / 목적어 → **whomever**
✗ to **whomever** needs it / ✗ Whomever you meet **them**
예) Give it to **whoever** needs it. / **Whomever** you meet, be polite.

groups.title: Day 5 / 가정법
cards: 가정법 과거, 과거완료 짝 맞추기

If S **과거**, S **would 원형** / If S **had p.p.**, S **would have p.p.**
✗ If I **knew** his number, I **will** call him / ✗ If I **would have** known
예) If I **had known**, I **would have told** you.
혼합 가정법 — if절은 과거완료, 주절은 현재(today, now)

If S **had p.p.** (과거), S **would 원형** + now, today (지금)
✗ If I had taken the medicine, I **would have felt** better **now**
예) If I **had taken** the medicine, I **would feel** better **now**.
가정법 미래 — If S should, were to 원형

If S **should 원형** (혹시라도), If S **were to 원형** (그럴 리 없지만)
✗ If it **should rains** / ✗ If the sun **were rise** in the west
예) If the sun **were to rise** in the west, I would change my mind.
I wish, as if + 가정법 과거 / 과거완료

**I wish, as if** + **과거**(지금과 반대) / **had p.p.**(과거와 반대)
✗ I wish I **am** rich / ✗ I wish I **studied** harder last year
예) I wish I **were** taller. / I wish I **had practiced** more.
if 생략 도치 — Were S, Had S p.p. , Should S

if 생략 → **Were S ~, Had S p.p. ~, Should S 원형 ~**
✗ **Had I knew** / ✗ **If had I** known
예) **Had I known** it, I would have helped. (= If I had known)
were it not for, had it not been for(= without, but for)

**Were it not for** (지금) / **Had it not been for** (과거) = **without, but for**
✗ **Was** it not for / ✗ Were it not for your help, I **would have failed**
예) **Had it not been for** your help, I **would have failed**.

groups.title: Day 5 / 전치사, 강조, 도치
cards: 전치사 to + 동명사(look forward to, lead to, object to)

look forward to, object to, be used to, lead to, devote A to + **-ing**
✗ look forward to **see** / ✗ be used to **get up** early (익숙하다)
예) I look forward to **seeing** you.
동명사의 의미상 주어는 소유격

동명사 앞 의미상 주어 → **소유격**(my, his, Tom's)
✗ **he** leaving early / ✗ **I** opening the window
예) Do you mind **my** opening the window?
완료 기한 by ↔ 계속 until / for ↔ during

**by**(그때까지 끝냄) ↔ **until**(그때까지 계속) / **for** + 숫자 기간 ↔ **during** + 사건 명사
✗ finish it **until** Friday / ✗ **during** three hours
예) Finish it **by** Friday. / Wait **until** Friday. / **for** three hours, **during** the vacation
It is ~ that 강조 구문

**It is[was] + 강조할 말 + that** + 나머지 (사람이면 who)
✗ It is the roof **what** needs repair / ✗ It was the storm that **it** destroyed
예) **It was** Tom **that[who]** broke the window.
부정 강조 not ~ at all, 동사 강조 do

부정 강조 **not ~ at all** / 동사 강조 **do, does, did + 원형**
✗ He **did came** / ✗ She **does likes** it
예) He **did come** yesterday. / I don't like it **at all**.
부정어구 문두 도치 — 조동사, do + 주어 + 원형

**Never, Hardly, Little, Not until** 문두 → **조동사, do + S + 원형**
✗ Never **I have seen** / ✗ Little **he knew**
예) **Never have I seen** such a view. / **Little did he know**.
So, Such 문두 도치 — So 형용사/부사 + 조동사 + S ~ that

**So + 형용사/부사 + be, 조동사 + S** ~ that / **Such + be + S** ~ that
✗ So heavy **the box was** that / ✗ **Such heavy** was the box
예) **So heavy was the box** that I couldn't lift it.
as, than 뒤 도치와 대동사 맞추기

as, than 뒤 **대동사(do, be, 조동사) + S** — 앞 동사의 종류, 시제, 수에 맞춘다
✗ taller than **does** her sister (be동사 → is) / ✗ as fast as **did** he now (현재 → does)
예) He runs faster than **does** his brother.
유도부사 There, Here 도치 — 동사는 뒤의 주어에 맞춘다

**There, Here + V + S** → 동사는 **뒤의 주어**에 맞춘다
✗ There **is** many books / ✗ Here **come** the bus
예) There **are** many books. / Here **comes** the bus.

groups.title: Day 6 / 동사, 보어, 태, 조동사
cards: 한 문장 한 동사 — 접속사 없이 동사를 더 쓰면 to부정사, 관계사, 분사로

동사 하나 + 접속사 없는 둘째 동사 → **to부정사, 관계사절, 분사**
✗ was built **protect** the town / ✗ The boy, **lives** next door, ~
예) The wall was built **to protect** the town.
전치사 없이 목적어를 받는 동사 — resemble, marry, accompany, discuss, enter, reach, approach

**resemble, marry, accompany, discuss, enter, reach, approach** + 목적어
✗ resemble **with** / ✗ discuss **about** / ✗ reach **at**
예) She **resembles** her mother closely.
to부정사만 목적어로 받는 동사 — refuse, decide, plan, hope, agree, manage, promise

**refuse, decide, plan, hope, agree, manage, promise** + **to 원형**
✗ refuse **explaining** / ✗ decide **moving**
예) He **refused to answer** the question.
inform, notify, remind, warn + 사람 + of 명사 / that절

**inform, notify, remind, warn** + 사람 + **of 명사 / that절**
✗ inform them **the change** / ✗ inform **to** them
예) We **informed** them **of** the change.
2형식 동사 appear, seem, look, remain, sound + 형용사 보어(부사 ×)

**appear, seem, look, remain, sound, feel** + **형용사** (부사 ×)
✗ seemed **calmly** / ✗ remained **coldly**
예) The puppy **looked sleepy**.
It takes + 사람 + 시간 + to부정사 — ~하는 데 시간이 걸리다

**It takes (사람) 시간 to 원형** = ~하는 데 시간이 걸리다
✗ It took me an hour **fixing** it / ✗ It **spent** me an hour
예) **It took me** an hour **to fix** the bike.
지각, 사역동사 + 목적어 + 원형 / 수동이 되면 be p.p. + to부정사

**see, hear, notice / make, have, let** + 목적어 + **원형**(지각은 -ing도)
✗ had him **to phone** / ✗ was made **clean** (수동은 to clean)
예) I **saw** him **cross** the road. / He **was seen to cross** it.
모양이 비슷한 동사 — rise(rose) vs raise(raised), find(found) vs found(founded)

자동 **rise–rose–risen** / 타동 **raise–raised**, 설립 **found–founded**
✗ prices **raised** (목적어 없음) / ✗ was **found** by (세워졌다)
예) Prices **rose** by 3%. / The school **was founded** by a monk.
convince, persuade, inform + 사람 + that절 — 사람 목적어가 없으면 be convinced that

**convince, persuade, inform** + **사람** + that절 / 사람이 주어면 **be convinced that**
✗ They **were convincing** that ~ / ✗ I **convinced** that ~
예) I **am convinced** that we will win.
used to + 원형 vs be used to + -ing, may well + 원형

**used to + 원형**(예전에 ~했다), **be used to + -ing**(~에 익숙하다), **may well + 원형**
✗ used to **being** / ✗ is used to **get up**
예) He **used to be** shy. / She **may well be** angry.
조동사 + have p.p. — must have p.p.(틀림없이 ~했다) vs should have p.p.(~했어야 했는데)

**must have p.p.** 틀림없이 ~했다, **should have p.p.** ~했어야 했다, **can't have p.p.** ~했을 리 없다
✗ 했어야 했다 = **must** have paid / ✗ should **paid**
예) You **should have come** earlier.

groups.title: Day 6 / 명사, 대명사, 도치
cards: the + 형용사 = ~한 사람들(복수) — the young, the sick, the elderly, the poor

**the + 형용사** = ~한 사람들 → **복수 동사**
✗ help **poor** (명사 없음) / ✗ The rich **is**
예) **The elderly need** more care.
재귀대명사 — 목적어가 주어와 같은 사람이면 -self

목적어 = 주어 → **-self** (myself, yourself, himself, themselves)
✗ I cut **me** / ✗ **hisself** / ✗ **theirselves**
예) She **taught herself** French.
둘 중 하나 one, 나머지 하나 the other, 셋 이상 another, the others, others

둘: **one ~ the other** / 또 하나: **another** / 나머지 전부: **the others**
✗ (둘 중) one ~ **another** / ✗ 나머지 전부 **others**
예) I have two sisters; **one** is a nurse, and **the other** is a pilot.
도치 문장의 동사는 뒤의 진짜 주어에 — 문두 보어, 장소구 / as, than 뒤 / So + 동사 + 주어

**보어, 장소구 / as, than / So** + **동사 + 주어** → 동사는 **뒤 주어**에
✗ Among the guests **was** two actors / ✗ as **does** the gases
예) On the table **were** two letters.

groups.title: Day 6 / 준동사, 분사구문, 비교
cards: to부정사가 꾸미는 명사가 전치사의 목적어면 전치사를 남긴다 — a chair to sit on

명사 + **to + 자동사 + 전치사** (a chair to **sit on**)
✗ a house to **live** / ✗ friends to **depend**
예) She needs someone **to talk to**.
준동사의 수동형 — 당하면 to be p.p. , being p.p. / need, want + -ing는 수동 뜻

당하면 **to be p.p. , being p.p.** / **need, want, require + -ing** = 수동 뜻
✗ is likely **to find** (발견될) / ✗ needs **being repaired**
예) The roof **needs repairing** (= needs **to be repaired**).
분사구문과 with + 명사 + 분사 — 하면 -ing, 당하면 p.p.

주어가 하면 **-ing**, 당하면 **p.p.** / **with + 명사 + -ing, p.p.**
✗ **Bearing** in Seoul, he ~ / ✗ with his legs **crossing**
예) **Born** in Seoul, he ~ / with **eyes closed**
독립분사구문과 완료분사구문 — 주어가 다르면 남기고, 먼저면 having p.p.

주어가 다르면 **주어 + -ing** (The sun having set), 먼저 일어났으면 **having p.p.**
✗ **Being** cold, we stayed in (주어 it 빠짐) / ✗ **Losing** it yesterday, I now ~
예) **It being** Sunday, the shop was closed.
A is no more B than C — C가 아니듯 A도 아니다, no less ~ than

**A no more ~ than B** = B가 아니듯 A도 아니다 / **no less ~ than** = B만큼 A도
✗ no more ~ **as** B / ✗ than a stone **can't**
예) A whale is **no more** a fish **than** a horse is.
비교급 강조 — much, far, even, still, a lot + 비교급(very ×)

**much, far, even, still, a lot** + 비교급 (훨씬)
✗ **very** stronger / ✗ much **strong** than
예) This box is **much heavier** than that one.
to가 전치사인 표현 + 동명사 — look forward to, object to, when it comes to

**look forward to, object to, when it comes to, be committed to** + **-ing**
✗ look forward to **go** / ✗ object to **pay**
예) I'm **looking forward to seeing** you.

groups.title: Day 6 / 접속사, 관계사
cards: ‘~인지 아닌지’ whether (or not) — if or not ×

**whether (or not)** ~ / if는 동사 뒤 목적어 자리에서만
✗ I wonder **if or not** ~ / ✗ **If** he comes is unclear
예) I wonder **whether or not** he will come.
목적어, 주어가 빠진 절 앞은 what(= the thing which) — 완전한 절 앞은 that

빠진 자리 있음 → **what** (= the thing which) / 완전한 절 → **that**
✗ This is **that** she needs / ✗ I know **what** he is honest
예) **What** we need is time.
lest + 주어 + (should) 원형 — lest 절에 not, didn't를 또 쓰지 않는다

**lest + 주어 + (should) + 원형** = ~하지 않도록
✗ lest he **didn't fall**, ✗ lest she **should not** forget
예) He ran **lest he (should) miss** the bus.
관계대명사의 격 — 삽입절(I think)은 빼고 보고, some, most of 뒤는 whom, which

삽입절(**I think, I believe**) 빼고 동사가 오면 **who** / **some, most, all of + whom, which**
✗ a player **whom** I think is / ✗ friends, some of **them** are
예) the man **who** I believe is honest / cousins, **some of whom** live abroad
완전한 절 앞은 전치사 + which(= where, when, why)

뒤가 **완전한 절** → **전치사 + which** = **where, when, why** (which 혼자 ×)
✗ the room **which** we slept / ✗ the day **which** we met
예) the house **in which** (= **where**) he was born

groups.title: Day 7 / 동사 뒤의 형태, 시제, 가정법
cards: 목적격보어 — catch, find, keep + 목적어 + -ing / order, ask, tell + 목적어 + to (be p.p.)

**catch, find, keep, leave** + 목적어 + **-ing** / **order, ask, tell** + 목적어 + **to (be p.p.)**
✗ caught him **to steal** / ✗ ordered the door **be locked**
예) She **found** him **sleeping**. / He **ordered** the gate **to be locked**.
가정법 과거완료, 혼합 가정법 — 과거 반대면 would have p.p., 지금 결과면 would 원형

둘 다 과거 사실의 반대, 결과의 때만 다르다 / 결과도 그때 **If + had p.p., would have p.p.** / 결과는 지금 **If + had p.p., would 원형 (now)**
✗ If you **practiced** more, you could **have won** ~ / ✗ If I **would have** known
예) If I **had taken** the job, I **would be** rich **now**.
때, 조건 부사절은 현재시제로 미래 — as soon as, when, until, if 뒤 will ×

**when, as soon as, before, until, if, unless** 부사절 → **현재시제**로 미래
✗ as soon as I **will arrive** / ✗ when I**'ll be** lying
예) I'll call you **when I arrive**.
현재완료와 함께 못 쓰는 말 — last year, ago, yesterday는 과거시제, 현재완료는 since

**last year, ago, yesterday, When ~?** → **과거시제** / 현재완료는 **since, for**
✗ has been empty **last spring** / ✗ **When have** you seen it?
예) The hotel **closed** last year. / It **has been empty since** last spring.
prevent, deter, keep + 목적어 + from -ing / remind + 사람 + of 명사

**prevent, deter, keep, stop** + 목적어 + **from -ing** / **remind** + 사람 + **of** 명사
✗ deter fans **to come** / ✗ remind you **our meeting**
예) The rain **kept** us **from going** out.
동명사 관용 표현 — be worth, be busy, have difficulty, cannot help, spend 시간 + -ing

**be worth, be busy, have difficulty, cannot help, spend 시간** + **-ing**
✗ worth **visited** / ✗ busy **to prepare**
예) The museum **is worth visiting**.
I wish, as if + 가정법 — 지금 반대는 과거형, 과거 반대는 had p.p.

**I wish, as if** + **과거형**(지금 반대) / **had p.p.**(과거 반대)
✗ I wish I **am** rich / ✗ I wish you **came** yesterday
예) I wish you **had come** earlier.
No sooner had S p.p. than / Hardly, Scarcely had S p.p. when — ~하자마자

**No sooner had S p.p. than** ~ / **Hardly, Scarcely had S p.p. when, before** ~
✗ No sooner ~ **when** / ✗ Hardly ~ **than** / ✗ No sooner **he had**
예) **No sooner had** I sat down **than** the phone rang.
자동사 + 전치사 — object to, complain about, listen to, reply to, arrive at

**object to, complain about, listen to, reply to, arrive at** + 목적어
✗ objected **her plan** / ✗ replied **the letter**
예) They **objected to** the plan.
자동사는 수동태가 없다 — appear, happen, occur, disappear, consist of

자동사 **appear, happen, occur, disappear, exist, consist of** → **수동태 ×**
✗ will **be appeared** / ✗ **was happened** / ✗ is **consisted of**
예) The article **will appear** tomorrow.
주장, 요구, 제안 동사 + that + 주어 + (should) 원형

**insist, demand, suggest, propose, recommend** + that + S + **(should) 원형**
✗ insisted that the store **opens** / ✗ proposed that he **goes**
예) She **suggested** that he **(should) see** a doctor.
remember, forget, regret + -ing(지난 일) / + to 원형(할 일), 동명사의 의미상 주어는 소유격

**remember, forget, regret + -ing** 지난 일 / **+ to 원형** 할 일 / 의미상 주어 **his, my**
✗ remember **to tell** me (지난 일) / ✗ forget **locking** the door (할 일)
예) I **remember meeting** her. / **Remember to lock** the door.

groups.title: Day 7 / 수 일치, 명사, 꾸미는 말
cards: 셀 수 없는 명사 homework, information, advice, furniture, equipment — 복수 ×, much, a piece of

**homework, information, advice, furniture, equipment, luggage** → 복수 ×, **much / a piece of**
✗ **homeworks** / ✗ **many** advices / ✗ **an** information
예) She gave me **a piece of advice**.
수식어가 낀 주어 — of ~, 분사구, 관계사절을 걷어내고 진짜 주어에 동사를 맞춘다

**주어 + (of ~ / 분사구 / 관계사절)** + 동사 → 동사는 **앞의 진짜 주어**에
✗ The capability of the forces **are** / ✗ A notice showing sales **are**
예) The keys **to the door are** missing.
부분사 + of + 명사 — two-thirds, most, half, some of 뒤 명사에 동사를 맞춘다

**분수, some, most, half, all + of + 명사** → 동사는 **of 뒤 명사**에
✗ Two-thirds of the milk **are** / ✗ Most of the students **is**
예) Half of the cake **is** gone. / Half of the cookies **are** gone.
동사를 또 쓰지 말고 분사로 — 자동사는 -ing로 명사를 꾸민다(weather occurring)

명사 + **자동사 -ing** (occurring, remaining, existing) / 접속사 없이 동사 둘 ×
✗ warm days **occur** in spring (동사가 또 옴) / ✗ the **remained** seats
예) a stretch of warm days **occurring** in spring
접속사를 남긴 분사구문(while playing)과 과거분사 분사구문(Left alone)

**(접속사) + -ing** 주어가 할 때 / **(접속사) + p.p.** 당할 때
✗ while **played** tennis / ✗ **Leaving** alone, he ~ (남겨짐)
예) He hurt his knee **while playing**. / **Left alone**, she read.
수사 + 단위명사 + 형용사가 명사를 꾸미면 단위명사는 단수(a ten-year-old boy)

**수사-단위명사(단수)-형용사** + 명사 (a **ten-year-old** boy)
✗ a six hundred **years** old bridge / ✗ a **five-stories** building
예) a **two-hour** meeting / The boy is ten **years** old.
형용사 vs 부사 — 1형식 동사 뒤 꾸밈은 부사 / enough는 형용사, 부사 뒤

1형식 동사(**occur, happen, arrive, change**) 뒤는 **부사** / **형용사, 부사 + enough**
✗ happens very **abrupt** / ✗ **enough calm**
예) It happened **suddenly**. / He is **old enough** to drive.
가목적어 it — make, find, think + it + 형용사 + (for 사람) + to부정사

**make, find, think + it + 형용사 + (for 목적격) + to부정사, that절**
✗ made **farmers difficult to** plan / ✗ found **to learn** Greek hard
예) The noise **made it hard for us to sleep**.
동명사구, to부정사구, 명사절 주어는 단수 동사

**동명사구, to부정사구, 명사절** 주어 → **단수 동사**
✗ Taking care of the kids **are** / ✗ Reading books **make** us wise
예) **Walking** in the woods **relaxes** me.

groups.title: Day 7 / 절, 강조, 비교, 부정
cards: 간접의문문 어순 — 의문사 + 주어 + 동사 (명사절이라 will 가능)

간접의문문 = **의문사 + 주어 + 동사** (명사절이라 will도 가능)
✗ Do you know when **will the museum** open? , ✗ I wonder where **is he**
예) Do you know **when the bus leaves**?
강조 — do, does, did + 원형 / 부정 강조 by no means, not ~ at all

동사 강조 **do, does, did + 원형** / 부정 강조 **by no means, not ~ at all**
✗ He **did loved** it / ✗ by no means **not** perfect
예) She **did call** me. / It is **by no means** easy.
however + 형용사, 부사(+ 명사) + 주어 + 동사 — 아무리 ~해도

**however + 형용사, 부사(+ 명사) + 주어 + 동사** = 아무리 ~해도
✗ **however it may cause** much stress / ✗ **however you are** tired
예) **However much noise it makes**, we must go on.
소유격 관계대명사 whose + 명사 — 선행사의 ~(which + 명사 ×)

선행사 + **whose + 명사** (선행사의 명사) — 뒤 절은 완전
✗ a player **which door** / ✗ a girl **her** father is a pilot
예) a house **whose roof** is red
and로 나열한 말은 같은 품사 — 명사 사이에 형용사를 끼우지 않는다

A, B, **and** C → **같은 품사**(명사, 명사, 명사)
✗ the **strong**, speed, and size / ✗ quickly, **quiet**, and carefully
예) its **strength**, speed, and size
비교급의 짝 — than 앞은 비교급(far, much 강조), The 비교급 ~, the 비교급 ~

**비교급 + than** (far, much 강조) / **The 비교급 + S + V, the 비교급 + S + V**
✗ far **great** ~ than / ✗ The younger ~, **more easily** ~
예) **The more** you practice, **the better** you play.
장소 선행사 뒤 — 절이 완전하면 where, 목적어, 주어가 빠졌으면 which

장소 선행사 + **where + 완전한 절** / 빠진 자리 있으면 **which, that**
✗ the town **which** I grew up / ✗ the city **where** I visited
예) places **where** a shop needs help
부분부정 not always, not all, not every vs 전체부정 never, none, no

부분부정 **not always, not all, not every, not both** / 전체부정 **never, none, no**
✗ ‘항상 ~은 아니다’ = **didn't** depend, ✗ ‘모두 ~은 아니다’ = **none** of
예) Old maps are **not always** accurate.
차이의 by — increase, decrease, rise, fall + by 수치(~만큼)

**increase, decrease, rise, fall, differ + by 수치** (~만큼)
✗ increased **for** thirty percent / ✗ fell **with** 3%
예) Sales **rose by** 10%.

groups.title: Day 8 / 동사 뒤의 꼴
cards: regret, remember + -ing는 이미 한 일, + to는 할 일 / stop -ing는 하던 것을 멈춤

**regret, remember + -ing** = 한 일 / **+ to 원형** = 할 일 / **stop -ing** = 그만두다
✗ I **regret to tell** him the secret yesterday. , ✗ He **stopped to smoke**(끊었다).
예) I **regret telling** him. / We **regret to inform** you that ~
let, make + 목적어 + 원형, cause + 목적어 + to, help는 원형, to 둘 다

**let, make** + O + **원형** / **cause, allow** + O + **to 원형** / **help** + O + **(to) 원형**
✗ let me **to go** / ✗ made us **running** / ✗ caused it **fall**
예) The map **helped** us **find** the hotel.
discuss, reach, enter, resemble + 목적어 — about, at, into, with ✗

**discuss, reach, enter, resemble, marry** + 목적어(전치사 없이)
✗ **discuss about** / ✗ **reach at** / ✗ **entered into** the hall / ✗ **resemble with**
예) We **reached the top** at noon.
sound, look, prove + 형용사 보어 — simply ✗ → simple

**sound, look, seem, prove, remain + 형용사**
✗ It **sounds simply**. , ✗ She **looked nervously**.
예) The plan **sounds simple**.

groups.title: Day 8 / 시제
cards: since + 과거 시점(절)이면 주절은 현재완료 — lives since ✗ → has lived since

**since + 과거 시점(절)** → 주절은 **have(has) p.p.**
✗ She **lives** here **since** 2019. , ✗ He **has left** two days **ago**.
예) I **have worked** here **since** I graduated.
Hardly had + 주어 + p.p. ~ when + 과거 — has ✗

**Hardly(Scarcely) had S p.p. ~ when(before) + 과거**
✗ Hardly **has** he left when ~ / ✗ Hardly had he left **than** ~
예) **Hardly had** we sat down **when** the lights went out.
시제 일치 — 주절이 said(과거)면 that절도 would, could

주절 **과거(said, told)** → that절 **would, could, was**
✗ He **said** he **will** come. , ✗ She told me she **can** swim.
예) He **said** that he **would** come.

groups.title: Day 8 / 어순
cards: 간접의문문 — tell, know, wonder 뒤는 의문사 + 주어 + 동사(do, does 없이)

**의문사 + 주어 + 동사** (문장 안의 의문문)
✗ I wonder what time **does the shop close**. , ✗ Tell me where **is the station**.
예) Tell me **where the station is**.
Seldom, Rarely, Never again 문두 → do(조동사) + 주어 + 동사

**Seldom, Rarely, Never again, Little** + **조동사(do) + 주어** + 동사
✗ Rarely **she visits** us. , ✗ Never again **I will** go there.
예) **Rarely does she visit** us. / **Never again will I** go there.
It is(was) ~ that 강조 — what, when ✗, It was not until ~ that

**It is(was) + 강조할 말 + that** ~ / **It was not until A that B**
✗ It is the price **what** matters. , ✗ It was not until noon **when** he woke.
예) **It was** my aunt **that** taught me to swim.
whose + 명사 + 완전한 절 — 소유 관계면 which, who ✗

**선행사 + whose + 명사** + (빠진 자리 없는 절)
✗ a singer **which songs** are famous / ✗ a house **who roof** leaks
예) I know a singer **whose songs** are famous.

groups.title: Day 8 / 비교
cards: 비교 대상 일치 — 사람이 아니라 소유대명사(yours), that of, those of

견주는 것끼리 같은 종류: **mine, yours, that of, those of**
✗ Her idea is better than **you**. , ✗ The price of gold is higher than **silver**.
예) Her idea is better than **yours**. / The price of gold is higher than **that of** silver.
not so much A as B(A라기보다 B), as 원급 as, 비교급 than 짝

**not so much A as B**, **as 원급 as**, **비교급 than**
✗ not so much a poet **than** a teacher / ✗ as **taller** as / ✗ taller **as**
예) He is **not so much** a poet **as** a teacher.
had better not + 원형, would rather A than B, may as well A as B

**had better (not) + 원형**, **would rather A than B**, **may as well A as B**
✗ had better **not to** go / ✗ would rather **to stay**
예) You **may as well** walk **as** wait for the bus.
배수사 + as 원급 as — three times as long as (as 사이 비교급 ✗)

**배수사 + as + 원급 + as** (twice, three times, half)
✗ twice **as larger as** / ✗ **as half** high **as**
예) This road is **three times as long as** that one.

groups.title: Day 8 / 꾸미는 말과 수 일치
cards: 감정 분사 — 감정을 느끼는 사람은 p.p.(bored), 일으키는 것은 -ing(boring)

느끼는 사람 **p.p.**(bored, amazed) / 일으키는 것 **-ing**(boring, amazing)
✗ We were **amazing** by the news. , ✗ The trip was **excited**.
예) The fans were **excited** by the **exciting** match.
형용사만 있으면 so, 명사까지 있으면 such (a) — such clever ✗

**so + 형용사** / **such + (a) + 형용사 + 명사**
✗ They are **such clever** that ~ / ✗ It was **so a long** day.
예) They are **so clever** that ~ / They are **such clever kids** that ~
a number of + 복수명사 + 복수동사 / the number of + 단수동사

**a number of + 복수명사 → 복수동사** / **the number of + 복수명사 → 단수동사**
✗ The number of tourists **have** risen. , ✗ There **is** a number of problems.
예) **A number of** students **are** absent. / **The number of** students **is** 30.
either A or B, neither A nor B 주어 — 동사는 B에 수일치

**either A or B, neither A nor B** + 동사는 **B**에 맞춤 / **both A and B** 는 복수
✗ Either you or he **are** to blame. , ✗ Neither the coach nor the players **was** ready.
예) **Either** you **or he is** to blame.
동사를 꾸미면 부사 — reviewed it careful ✗ → carefully

동사, do so를 꾸미는 자리 = **부사(-ly)**
✗ She did so **efficient**. , ✗ He drove **careful**.
예) She did so **efficiently**.

groups.title: Day 9 / 동사와 태
cards: locate, situate는 타동사 — ‘~에 위치하다’는 be located (locates ✗)

‘~에 있다’ = **be located, be situated** (locate는 타동사)
✗ The hotel **locates** by the lake. , ✗ The school **situates** downtown.
예) The hotel **is located** by the lake.
be accustomed to, look forward to, object to + -ing (to 원형 ✗)

**be accustomed(used) to, look forward to, object to + -ing**
✗ look forward to **see** you / ✗ be used to **live** alone
예) She **is accustomed to getting** up early.
동명사 수동 being p.p. — 당하는 쪽이면 hates treating ✗ → being treated

동명사가 당하면 **being p.p.** (의미상 주어 **his, its**)
✗ She hates **treating** like a child.(대우받는 뜻)
예) She hates **being treated** like a child.
think of, regard, refer to A as B — as ✗ 빠짐

**think of, regard, look on, refer to** + A + **as** + B
✗ We think of her **a reliable friend**. , ✗ is **referred as** ~
예) Many people **regard** him **as** a hero.
suggest, explain, introduce + 사람 + 물건 ✗ → 내용 + to 사람

**suggest, explain, introduce, announce** + 내용 + **to 사람**
✗ **suggested us** a plan / ✗ **explained me** the rule
예) She **suggested** a plan **to us**.

groups.title: Day 9 / 가정과 당위
cards: essential, important that절과 suggestion, demand that(동격) — (should) 원형

**important, essential, necessary** that + S + **(should) 원형** / **suggestion, demand that** + S + **(should) 원형**
✗ It is important that he **submits** ~ / ✗ her demand that it **is** delayed
예) It is essential that every guest **wear** a badge.
if 생략 도치 Had S p.p. → 주절 would have p.p.(과거 일)

**Had + S + p.p.** ~, S + **would have p.p.** / **Were S** ~, S + would 원형
✗ Had she left earlier, she **would catch** the train yesterday.
예) **Had she left** earlier, she **would have caught** the train.
It is (high) time + 주어 + 과거동사

**It is (high) time + S + 과거동사** (= should 원형)
✗ It is high time you **go** to bed.
예) It is high time you **went** to bed.

groups.title: Day 9 / 절
cards: not A but B, and, or 병렬 — 같은 꼴(to부정사, -ing, 부사)

**not A but B, A and B, A or B** → A, B는 **같은 꼴**
✗ reading, painting, and **to swim** / ✗ slowly and **clear**
예) My goal is **not to win but to finish**.
what + 빠진 자리 있는 절 / that + 완전한 절

**what + 불완전한 절**(~하는 것) / **that + 완전한 절**
✗ I don't know **that** she wants. , ✗ The problem is **what** we have no time.
예) I don't know **what** she wants.
양보 — 형용사(무관사 명사) + as + 주어 + 동사

**형용사, 무관사 명사 + as + 주어 + 동사** = 비록 ~지만
✗ **A rich man as** he is / ✗ **Strangely** as it may sound
예) **Tired as she was**, she kept working.
whoever — 전치사 뒤라도 절 안 주어면 whoever(whomever ✗)

절 안 **주어 → whoever** / 목적어 → whomever / 명사 앞 → **whichever, whatever + 명사**
✗ to **whomever** wins / ✗ **whomever** book you want
예) Give the prize to **whoever** wins.

groups.title: Day 9 / 분사
cards: 명사를 꾸미는 분사 — 다친 승객은 injured(당함), injuring ✗

명사가 **당하면 p.p.**(injured, located) / **하면 -ing**
✗ **injuring** passengers(다친 승객) / ✗ a city **locating** by a river
예) **Injured** passengers were taken to the hospital.
with + 목적어 + 분사 — 목적어가 하면 -ing(뒤에 목적어 있음), 당하면 p.p.

**with + O + -ing**(O가 함) / **with + O + p.p.**(O가 당함)
✗ with the factory **reduced** its staff / ✗ with his eyes **closing**
예) **With** prices **rising**, people spend less.

groups.title: Day 9 / 수 일치와 명사
cards: news, information은 단수 취급 — The news were ✗ → was

**news, information, advice, furniture** → **단수동사**, many, a ✗
✗ The news **were** shocking. , ✗ **many** informations
예) The news **was** shocking.
A set, series, combination of + 복수명사 — 동사는 앞 명사(단수)에

**A set, series, combination, The quality of + 복수명사** → **단수동사**
✗ A series of storms **have** hit. , ✗ The quality of the apples **are** high.
예) **A set of keys was** found.
Many a + 단수명사 + 단수동사

**Many a + 단수명사 + 단수동사** (많은 ~)
✗ Many a student **have** failed. , ✗ Many a **students**
예) **Many a student has** failed.

groups.title: Day 9 / 비교
cards: 비교급 + than any other + 단수명사 = 최상급

**비교급 + than any other + 단수명사** / **No + 단수명사 + 비교급 than**
✗ than any other **students** / ✗ No city is **so crowded than** Seoul.
예) Seoul is busier **than any other city** in Korea.
superior, inferior, senior, junior + to (than ✗ / more ✗)

**superior, inferior, senior, junior, prefer + to**
✗ **inferior than** / ✗ **more superior** to
예) This cloth is **inferior to** that one.
비교 대상의 꼴 — as to rest as to eat, than driving

견주는 둘은 같은 꼴: **to부정사 ↔ to부정사 / -ing ↔ -ing**
✗ as important **to rest** as **eat** / ✗ Walking is better than **drive**.
예) It is as important **to rest** as **to eat**.

groups.title: Day 10 / 목적격보어와 수동
cards: have, see + 목적어 + p.p. — 목적어가 당하면 p.p.(be p.p. ✗)

**have, get, see, hear** + O + **p.p.** (O가 당함)
✗ had my bike **repair** / ✗ have the bags **be checked** / ✗ saw him **arrest**
예) I **had** my bike **repaired**.
leave, keep, find + 목적어 + -ing(하고 있는 채로) — 원형 ✗

**leave, keep, find, catch** + O + **-ing**
✗ Don't leave the kids **play** alone. , ✗ kept the guests **wait**
예) Don't **leave** the kids **playing** alone.
keep, stop, prevent + 목적어 + from -ing (to ✗)

**keep, stop, prevent, prohibit** + O + **from -ing**
✗ kept the plane **to take** off / ✗ prevented us **go**
예) The storm **kept** the plane **from taking** off.
자동사 + 전치사의 수동 — be laughed at by(전치사 남김)

**be laughed at, be looked after, be dealt with** (+ by ~)
✗ was **laughed by** / ✗ will be **dealt** at the meeting
예) He hated **being laughed at** by others.

groups.title: Day 10 / 준동사
cards: 완료부정사 to have p.p. — 본동사보다 앞선 일(is known to have lived)

앞선 때 = **to have p.p.**, **having p.p.**
✗ He seems **to be** sick **yesterday**. , ✗ having **win**
예) He **is said to have lived** in Paris.
접속사 + 분사구문 — After, While + -ing(주어가 함), When + p.p.(당함)

**After, While, When, Though + -ing**(주어가 함) / **+ p.p.**(주어가 당함)
✗ **While walk** / ✗ **When asking** about it, he(질문받은 뜻)
예) **After finishing** the report, she went out.
there is를 분사구문으로 — There being (Being만 ✗)

주어가 다르면 남김: **The sun having set**, there is → **There being**
✗ **Being no buses**, we walked.
예) **There being** no buses, we took a taxi.
감정 분사 — 일, 사물이 감정을 일으키면 -ing(thrilling, tiring), 느끼면 p.p.

감정을 **일으키는** 일, 사물 → **-ing** / **느끼는** 사람 → **p.p.**
✗ The lecture was **bored**. , ✗ a **tired** journey / ✗ I was **confusing** by it.
예) The match was **thrilling**.

groups.title: Day 10 / 시제와 도치
cards: for + 기간 동안 지금도 하는 중 → 현재완료진행 have been -ing

**for + 기간, since + 시점** + 지금도 진행 → **have been -ing**
✗ She **is waiting** for an hour. , ✗ I **wait** here since noon.
예) She **has been waiting** for an hour.
Not until A 문두 → 주절 did + 주어 + 원형(until절 안은 그대로)

**Not until A + did(does) + S + 원형** = It was not until A that B
✗ Not until it stopped **we could** go. , ✗ Not until **did I read** it, ~
예) **Not until** it stopped **could we** go.
장소 부사구, 보어 문두 도치 — 동사는 뒤의 주어에 수일치(Among ~ were + 복수)

**부사구, 보어 + 동사 + 주어** → 동사는 **뒤 주어** 에 맞춤
✗ Among them **was** two singers. , ✗ On the hill **stand** a church.
예) Among the guests **were** two singers.

groups.title: Day 10 / 관계사와 대명사
cards: 콤마 뒤, 전치사 바로 뒤는 that ✗ → which, who

**, which / , who** / **전치사 + which, whom** (that ✗)
✗ My laptop, **that** is old, ~ / ✗ the house **in that** I live
예) My laptop, **which** is old, still works.
선행사가 있으면 that, which — a value what ✗

**선행사 + that, which** / 선행사 없음 → **what**
✗ a habit **what** helps / ✗ all **what** I know
예) It is a habit **that** helps you.
대명사 수 일치 — 단수 사물은 its (their ✗)

단수 명사 → **it, its** / 복수 명사 → **they, their**
✗ The castle is old, and **their** walls are cracked.
예) The castle is old, and **its** walls are cracked.

groups.title: Day 10 / 비교와 부정
cards: by far, much + 최상급 / much, far, even + 비교급 (very ✗)

최상급 강조 **by far, much** / 비교급 강조 **much, far, even, still**
✗ **very cheaper** / ✗ **far most** famous
예) This is **by far the most** popular dish.
The 비교급 + 주어 + 동사, the 비교급 + 주어 + 동사

**The + 비교급 + S + V, the + 비교급 + S + V**
✗ the **cold** it gets / ✗ the earlier **can you** rest / ✗ **More** you read
예) **The more** you practice, **the better** you become.
부정어 중복 금지 — can't hardly ✗ → can hardly

**hardly, scarcely, seldom, never** + not ✗
✗ I **can't hardly** hear you. , ✗ He **didn't scarcely** eat.
예) I **can hardly** hear you.
부분부정 not necessarily, not always — 반드시(항상) ~인 것은 아니다

**not + necessarily, always, all, every** = 부분부정 / never, none, not ~ at all = 전체부정
✗ ‘항상 늦는 것은 아니다’ → He is **never** late.
예) Expensive things are **not necessarily** good.

groups.title: Day 10 / 수량과 used to
cards: 막연히 많은 수는 thousands of (thousand of ✗), 숫자와 쓰면 단수

막연히 많음 **thousands(hundreds, millions) of** / 숫자 + **thousand**(단수)
✗ **thousand of** fans / ✗ three **thousands** fans
예) **Thousands of** fans came.
used to + 원형(예전에 ~였다) / be used to -ing(익숙하다)

**used to + 원형** 예전엔 / **be used to + -ing** 익숙하다 / **be used to + 원형** 쓰이다
✗ This building **was used to be** a school.(예전엔 학교였다)
예) This building **used to be** a school.

groups.title: Day 11 / 동사 자리와 대동사
cards: 한 절에 본동사는 하나 — Eat ~ can raise ✗ → Eating ~ can raise / is depends ✗ → depends

**한 절 = 본동사 하나** → 주어 자리 동사는 **-ing, to 원형**, 꾸미는 동사는 **분사**
✗ **Skip** breakfast makes me sleepy. , ✗ The result **is depends** on ~
예) **Skipping** breakfast **makes** me sleepy.
so, neither + 동사 + 주어 — 앞 절 동사 종류와 뒤 주어의 수에 맞춤, was ~, so did ✗ → so were

긍정 + **so + 동사 + 주어** / 부정 + **neither(nor) + 동사 + 주어** — 동사는 앞 절 종류(be, 조동사, do), 수는 뒤 주어
✗ She can swim, and **so does** her son. , ✗ He isn't ready, and **neither I am**.
예) She **can** swim, and **so can** her son.
rise(오르다, 목적어 없음), raise(올리다, 목적어 있음) — will rise fares ✗ → will raise fares

**rise – rose – risen**(오르다, 목적어 ×) / **raise – raised – raised**(올리다, 목적어 ○)
✗ The firm will **rise** wages. , ✗ The balloon was **raising** into the sky.
예) Wages **rose**. / The firm **raised** wages.
부가의문문 — 주절의 주어(대명사)와 동사 종류, 시제에 맞춤, have eaten ~, didn't they ✗ → haven't they

**주절 주어 → 대명사**, 동사는 주절과 같은 종류, 시제(be → be / 조동사 → 조동사 / 일반동사 → do), 긍정문 뒤는 부정 / 부정문 뒤는 긍정
✗ You have met him, **didn't** you? , ✗ It is true that he won, **didn't he**?
예) You **know** him, **don't you**?
to부정사, 동명사 주어는 단수 동사 — To raise three children alone require ✗ → requires

**To 원형 ~ / -ing ~ (주어) + 단수동사** — 바로 앞 복수명사에 끌려가지 않는다
✗ To make friends **are** easy for her. , ✗ Keeping two dogs **cost** a lot.
예) **Keeping** two dogs **costs** a lot.

groups.title: Day 11 / 조동사와 가정법
cards: 조동사 + have p.p. — should have p.p.(했어야 했는데), must have p.p.(했음이 틀림없다), cannot have p.p.(했을 리 없다)

**should have p.p.** 했어야 했는데 / **must have p.p.** 했음이 틀림없다 / **cannot have p.p.** 했을 리 없다 / **may have p.p.** 했을지도
✗ He **should have been** sick(틀림없이 아팠다는 뜻으로). , ✗ You must **have saw** it.
예) You **should have called** first. / The lake **must have frozen** overnight.
I wish + had p.p.(지난 일의 아쉬움), I wish + 과거형(지금의 아쉬움) — I wish I attended yesterday ✗ / I wish I have ✗

지난 일 **I wish + 주어 + had p.p.** / 지금 **I wish + 주어 + 과거형(had, were, could)**
✗ I wish I **brought** an umbrella this morning. , ✗ I wish I **know** his number.
예) I wish I **had brought** an umbrella this morning.
lest + 주어 + (should) 동사원형 — lest 자체가 ‘~하지 않도록’이라 not을 또 쓰지 않음, lest she should not disturb ✗

**lest + 주어 + (should) + 동사원형** = ~하지 않도록 (not을 또 쓰지 않는다)
✗ lest he **should not** catch a cold / ✗ lest the plan **won't** fail
예) Hurry up **lest** you **should miss** the bus.

groups.title: Day 11 / 동명사와 to부정사
cards: 전치사(of, for, without, by, in, at) 뒤는 동명사 — without say ✗ → without saying

**전치사(of, for, in, at, by, without, instead of) + -ing**
✗ by **work** hard / ✗ fond of **to cook**
예) He is fond **of cooking** for his friends.
형용사 + enough + to부정사, too + 형용사 + to부정사 — enough large ✗ → large enough

**형용사 + enough + to 원형** / **too + 형용사 + (for 사람) + to 원형**
✗ **enough warm** to eat / ✗ too sleepy **driving** / ✗ too dark **that** ~
예) The soup is **warm enough to** eat.
have difficulty, be busy, spend 시간, be worth, cannot help + -ing — difficulty to read ✗ → difficulty reading

**have difficulty(trouble) -ing**, **be busy -ing**, **spend 시간 -ing**, **be worth -ing**, **cannot help -ing**
✗ have trouble **to park** / ✗ busy **to study** / ✗ worth **to read**
예) I am **busy studying** for the finals.
manage, decide, refuse, afford, promise + to부정사 — managed finishing ✗ → managed to finish

**manage, decide, refuse, afford, promise, hope, plan, agree, fail, pretend + to 원형**
✗ agreed **waiting** / ✗ planned **leaving** / ✗ pretended **sleeping**
예) They **agreed to wait** until Friday.
분사, to부정사, 동명사의 not은 바로 앞에 — Knowing not ✗ → Not knowing, to don't open ✗ → not to open

**not + -ing(분사, 동명사)**, **not + to 원형**
✗ **Hearing not** the bell ~ / ✗ asked me **to don't** tell ~
예) **Not hearing** the bell, I stayed in my seat.

groups.title: Day 11 / 접속사와 관계부사
cards: 뒤에 절이면 because, although, while, 명사면 because of, despite, during — because of it rained ✗

**because, although, while + 주어 + 동사** / **because of, despite, during + 명사**
✗ **because of** he was ill / ✗ **Despite** it snowed / ✗ **during** we were eating
예) **Although** it snowed, the buses ran on time. / **Despite** the snow, the buses ran on time.
전치사 뒤, or not 바로 앞, to부정사 앞은 whether — depends on that ✗ / if or not ✗

**전치사 + whether**, **whether or not**, **whether to 원형** (이 자리에 that은 못 쓴다. 시험에서는 if도 쓰지 않는다)
✗ depends on **that** she comes / ✗ **if or not** it will snow / ✗ **if to** stay
예) It depends on **whether** she comes.
뒤 절이 완전하면 where, when, why, 전치사 + which — the village which she grew up ✗ → where(in which)

**완전한 절 앞 = where, when, why, 전치사 + which** / **빠진 자리가 있는 절 앞 = which, that**
✗ the office **which** he works / ✗ the bridge **where** they built
예) This is the office **where**(= **in which**) he works.

groups.title: Day 11 / 형용사, 대명사, 보어
cards: 수사-단위명사(-형용사)가 명사를 꾸미면 단위명사는 단수 — a ten-years-old girl ✗ → a ten-year-old girl

**수사-단수 단위명사(-형용사) + 명사** / 보어로 혼자 쓰면 복수(nine **years** old)
✗ a six-**years**-old boy / ✗ a four-**weeks** course / ✗ She is nine **year** old.
예) a **four-week** course / a **six-year-old** boy
주어와 목적어가 같은 사람이면 재귀대명사 — I taught me ✗ → myself / enjoyed us ✗ → ourselves

주어 = 목적어(같은 사람) → **myself, yourself, himself, herself, ourselves, themselves**
✗ I cut **me** on the glass. , ✗ We introduced **us**.
예) I cut **myself** on the glass.
consider, believe, say, make, tell의 수동태 뒤는 to부정사 — is considered be ✗ → to be / were made stay ✗ → to stay

**be considered(believed, said, thought, expected, told, allowed, made) + to 원형**
✗ is known **be** / ✗ is said **living** / ✗ were made **pay**
예) She **is known to be** generous to her neighbors.
convenient, possible, necessary, difficult는 사람 주어로 못 씀 — You are impossible to finish ✗ → It is impossible for you to finish

**It is convenient(possible, necessary, difficult) + for 사람 + to 원형** — 사람을 주어로 ✗
✗ **I am not convenient** to meet today. , ✗ **We are difficult** to find parking.
예) **It is not convenient for me** to meet today.

groups.title: Day 12 / 시제와 때 표현
cards: 때, 조건 부사절은 will 없이 현재시제 — until the rain will stop ✗ → until the rain stops

**when, until, before, after, if, unless** 부사절 → **will 없이 현재**
✗ I'll wait until he **will come**. , ✗ If it **will rain** tomorrow, we'll stay home.
예) I'll wait **until** he **comes**. / I don't know **if** he **will come**. (~인지)
과거의 기준 때보다 먼저 일어난 일은 had p.p. — when I arrived, it has started ✗ → had started

과거(arrived, found)보다 **먼저** 일어난 일 → **had p.p.**
✗ When I arrived, the show **has** already **started**.
예) When I arrived, the show **had** already **started**.
for + 숫자 기간, during + 명사 / until 계속, by 기한 — during two hours ✗ → for two hours

**for + 숫자 기간**, **during + 명사** / **until** = 계속 / **by** = 기한
✗ We talked **during** two hours. , ✗ Submit it **until** Monday.
예) We talked **for** two hours. / Submit it **by** Monday.

groups.title: Day 12 / 가정법과 조동사
cards: 혼합 가정법 — If + had p.p.(지난 일), would + 동사원형 ~ now(지금의 결과)

**If + 주어 + had p.p. ~, 주어 + would + 동사원형 ~ now**
✗ If I had left early, I **will** be home now. , ✗ If I **left** early then, I would be home now.
예) **If** I **had left** early, I **would be** home **now**.
동사 강조 do, does, did + 동사원형, by no means(결코 ~ 아니다) — does looks ✗ → does look

**do, does, did + 동사원형** = 정말 ~하다 / **by no means**(= not at all) = 결코 ~ 아니다
✗ She **does likes** it. , ✗ I **did saw** him. , ✗ It is **not by no means** easy.
예) She **does like** it. / It is **by no means** easy.
If + 주어 + were to, should + 동사원형(일어날 것 같지 않은 앞일, 혹시) — were erupt ✗ → were to erupt

**If + 주어 + were to + 원형, would + 원형** / **If + 주어 + should + 원형, 명령문**
✗ If it **were snow** in July, ~ / ✗ If he **should calls**, ~
예) **If** you **should need** help, **call** me.
조동사 need, dare는 -s, to 없이 + 원형(need not go), 일반동사는 needs to, doesn't need to

조동사: **need not + 원형, How dare + 주어 + 원형** / 일반동사: **needs to + 원형**
✗ He **needs not** go. , ✗ He need not **to go**. , ✗ How dare he **says** so?
예) He **need not go**. = He **doesn't need to go**.

groups.title: Day 12 / 동사와 목적어
cards: 가목적어 it — find, make, think + it + 형용사 + to부정사(find difficult to ✗ → find it difficult to)

**find, make, think, consider + it + 형용사 + to부정사**
✗ I **found hard** to sleep. , ✗ The lift **makes simple** to move boxes.
예) I **found it hard to** sleep on the night bus.
mind, deny, avoid, finish, suggest 뒤는 동명사, 의미상 주어는 소유격이 원칙 — mind to wait ✗ → mind waiting

**mind, deny, avoid, finish, enjoy, suggest + -ing** / 의미상 주어는 **소유격(my, his) + -ing** 가 원칙, 목적격(me, him)도 씀
✗ He denied **to break** it. , ✗ Would you mind **for me to sit** here?
예) Would you **mind my sitting** here?
convince, inform, remind, rob + 사람 + of + 내용 — informed us the change ✗ → informed us of the change

**convince, inform, notify, remind, rob, deprive + 사람 + of + 내용**
✗ He informed me **the news**. , ✗ It reminds me **my** school days.
예) He **informed** me **of** the news.
talk, listen, wait, reply, arrive는 자동사 — 목적어 앞에 전치사(talked me ✗ → talked to me)

**talk to, listen to, reply to, wait for, arrive at, complain about** + 목적어
✗ She **talked me** about it. , ✗ We **listened the** radio.
예) She **talked to** me about it.

groups.title: Day 12 / 수동태와 준동사
cards: give, offer, tell의 수동태 — 받는 사람이 주어, be p.p. 뒤에 직접목적어가 남음(was given a prize)

받는 사람 + **be given(offered, told, shown) + 직접목적어**
✗ She **gave** a prize by the school. , ✗ She was given **to** a prize.
예) She **was given a prize** by the school.
call, name, elect의 수동태 — be called 뒤에 보어가 그대로(is called as ✗), regard, know는 as 필요

**be called(named, elected) + 보어** / **be regarded(known) as + 보어**
✗ It **is called as** the Blue House. , ✗ He **is regarded** a hero.
예) It **is called** the Blue House.
명사 + to부정사 + 전치사 — no friends to rely ✗ → to rely on, a house to live in

명사 + **to + 자동사 + 전치사**(a bed to sleep **in**, a pen pal to write **to**, a spoon to eat **with**)
✗ a bed **to sleep** / ✗ a spoon **to eat** / ✗ a film **to watch it**
예) The baby needs a bed **to sleep in**.
분사구문의 태 — 주절의 주어가 하면 -ing, 당하면 p.p.(Surrounding by ✗ → Surrounded by)

주어가 **하면 -ing** / 주어가 **당하면 p.p.**
✗ **Building** in 1900, the hall ~ / ✗ **Opened** the box, he ~
예) **Built** in 1900, the hall is still in use.

groups.title: Day 12 / 수량 표현과 절
cards: 분수, half, most + of + 명사 — 동사는 of 뒤 명사에 맞춤(복수명사면 복수 동사, 셀 수 없으면 단수)

**the rest, half, most, 분수 + of + 복수명사 → 복수 동사** / **+ 셀 수 없는 명사 → 단수 동사**
✗ Two-thirds of the students **is** absent. , ✗ Half of the money **were** stolen.
예) **Two-thirds of** the students **are** absent.
the + 형용사 = ~한 사람들(복수 취급) — The poors ✗ / The unemployed is ✗ → The unemployed are

**the + 형용사** = ~한 사람들 → **복수 동사**(사람들 전체를 가리킬 때)
✗ **The poors** need help. , ✗ The elderly **is** at risk.
예) **The elderly are** at risk in hot weather.
a few, few + 셀 수 있는 복수명사 / a little, little + 셀 수 없는 명사 — a little coins ✗ → a few coins

**a few, few + 복수명사** / **a little, little + 셀 수 없는 명사**
✗ **a little** chairs / ✗ **a few** water / ✗ **few** information
예) She bought **a few** stamps and **a little** ink.
What is ~ like, What do you call ~, What do you think of ~ — How ~ like ✗ → What ~ like

**What** is(does) ~ **like**? , **What** do you **call**(think of) ~?
✗ **How** is the hotel **like**? , ✗ **How** do people call that fish?
예) **What** is the hotel **like**? = **How** is the hotel?
수량 표현 + of whom(사람), of which(사물)로 두 절을 이음 — , some of them are ✗ → some of whom are

명사, **some, most, both, two + of whom(사람), of which(사물)** + 동사
✗ He has two sons, both of **them** are tall. , ✗ ten books, some of **whom** ~
예) He has two sons, **both of whom** are tall.

groups.title: Day 13 / to부정사의 쓰임
cards: to부정사의 주어가 당하는 쪽이면 to be p.p. — have to submit ✗ → have to be submitted

당하는 쪽 + **to be p.p.**
✗ The windows need **to wash**. , ✗ She expects **to promote** soon.
예) The windows need **to be washed** once a month.
의미상 주어 — 성품 형용사(kind, careless) 뒤 of, 일의 성질(easy, impossible) 뒤 for

**성품 형용사(kind, wise) + of 사람** + to 원형 / **일의 성질 형용사(hard, safe) + for 사람** + to 원형
✗ It is **safe of children** to swim here. , ✗ It was **rude for him** to shout.
예) It was **rude of him** to shout. / It is **safe for children** to swim here.
명사 + to부정사(꾸밈) — 전치사를 남기고(a room to study in) it은 다시 쓰지 않는다

**명사 + to 원형** (+ 남는 전치사) / **-thing + 형용사 + to 원형**
✗ a sofa **to lie** / ✗ a box to put toys **in it** / ✗ a chance **winning** it
예) a chance **to win** / a sofa **to lie on**
결과의 to부정사 — only to find, never to return, grow up to be (to 뒤는 원형)

**only to + 원형**(결국 ~했을 뿐), **never to + 원형**(다시는 ~못 했다), **grow up, live + to be**
✗ only **to lost** / ✗ never **to seeing** / ✗ grew up **became**
예) He left his hometown at twenty, **never to return**.
가주어 It ~ to부정사 — That, This, There ✗, 안의 의문문은 의문사 + 주어 + 동사

**It is + 형용사 + to 원형** + (의문사 + 주어 + 동사)
✗ **That** is wise to ask where the money goes. , ✗ It is wise to ask where **does the money go**.
예) **It is** wise **to ask where the money goes**.

groups.title: Day 13 / 비교와 가정
cards: no more than + 수 = 겨우 / no less than + 수 = 자그마치 — 뜻에 맞게, 짝은 than

**no more than** = 겨우(only) / **no less than** = 자그마치(as much as)
✗ 겨우 두 명 → **no less than** two people / ✗ no more **as** five miles
예) **No more than** two people came. / **No less than** two thousand people came.
Without, But for ~ 지난 일이면 would have p.p. — would find last night ✗

**Without, But for ~**, 주어 + **would(could) have p.p.**(지난 일) / **would(could) + 원형**(지금)
✗ But for the rain, we **would win** yesterday. , ✗ If it had not been **the** rain
예) **But for** the rain, we **would have won** yesterday.
may(might) as well A as B — A, B 원형, 사이는 as (than, to, -ing ✗)

**may(might) as well + 원형 A + as + 원형 B** = B하느니 A하는 편이 낫다
✗ may as well leave **than** stay / ✗ may as well **to quit** / ✗ as **staying**
예) You **may as well leave** **as stay** here all day.
not so much A as B — A, B는 같은 꼴(명사, 형용사, 전치사구끼리), but, than ✗

**not so much A as B**(A라기보다 B) — A, B **같은 꼴**
✗ not so much lazy **than** slow / ✗ not so much sad as **loneliness**
예) Success is **not so much** luck **as** effort.

groups.title: Day 13 / 어순
cards: 아무리 ~해도 — No matter how(However) + 형용사, 부사 + 주어 + 동사 (how you are busy ✗)

**No matter how(However) + 형용사, 부사 + 주어 + 동사**
✗ No matter how **the bag is heavy** / ✗ However **she spoke quietly**
예) **However heavy the bag is**, she carries it herself.
enough는 형용사, 부사 뒤 — enough large ✗ → large enough (to 원형)

**형용사, 부사 + enough** (+ to 원형) / **enough + 명사**
✗ **enough warm** to swim / ✗ walk **enough slowly**
예) The water is **warm enough** to swim in.
동사 + 부사의 대명사 목적어는 사이에 — turn down it ✗ → turn it down

**동사 + 대명사(it, them) + 부사** / 동사 + 전치사는 붙여서(wait for them)
✗ **give up it** / ✗ **call back them** / ✗ waiting **them for**
예) Smoking is harmful. Please **give it up**.
consider, find, make, keep + 목적어 + 보어 순서 — made tired the children ✗

**consider, find, make, keep, call + 목적어 + 보어**
✗ painted **green the fence** / ✗ left **alone it** / ✗ drives **crazy me**
예) The noise **drove the neighbors crazy**.
형용사 순서 — 의견, 크기, 나이, 색, 나라, 재료 + 명사 (a wooden beautiful old table ✗)

**의견 → 크기 → 나이 → 모양 → 색 → 나라 → 재료** + 명사
✗ a **paper cute pink** hat / ✗ a **green big** door
예) a **cute pink paper** hat

groups.title: Day 13 / 전치사 꼴과 수동태
cards: 잡으면 by the arm, 치면 on the head, 보면 in the eye — 전치사와 the 그대로

잡다 **catch, take, grab + 사람 + by the** 부위 / 두드리다 **pat, tap + 사람 + on the** 부위 / 눈, 얼굴 **look, hit + 사람 + in the** eye, face
머리(head)를 칠 때는 **on the, in the** 둘 다 쓴다
✗ held her **at the wrist** / ✗ patted him **by the back** / ✗ took me **by hand**
예) She **held** the child **by the wrist**.
of + 추상명사 = 형용사 — of no useful ✗ → of no use, with easy ✗ → with ease

**of + 추상명사** = 형용사(of use = useful / of importance = important / of value = valuable)
✗ of no **valuable** / ✗ of great **important** / ✗ with **difficult**
예) The ring is **of no value**. / Your help is **of great value**.
지각, 사역동사의 수동태 — was seen shake ✗ → to shake, were made clean ✗ → to clean

**be seen, be heard, be made + to 원형** (지각동사는 -ing도 됨)
✗ was seen **jump** / ✗ were made **stand** / ✗ was heard **shout**
예) The boy **was seen to jump** over the fence.

groups.title: Day 13 / 한정사와 부사
cards: each, every + 단수명사 + 단수 동사 — Each player have ✗ → has, each rooms ✗

**each, every + 단수명사 + 단수 동사**
✗ **Each driver have** / ✗ **Each cars** has / ✗ **Every women**
예) **Each driver** in the race **has** a number.
부정문 뒤 ‘~도’는 either — doesn't, neither ✗, can't, too ✗ / neither + 동사 + 주어

긍정 + **too** / 부정 + **not ~ either** / **neither + 조동사 + 주어**
✗ he isn't, **neither**, ✗ she won't, **too**, ✗ neither **we do**
예) Jisu doesn't eat meat, and her brother doesn't, **either**.
열심히, 세게는 hard, hardly는 거의 ~않다 — studied hardly ✗ → studied hard

**hard** = 열심히, 세게 / **hardly** = 거의 ~않다
✗ practiced **hardly** every day / ✗ kicked the ball **hardly** / ✗ I **hard** remember it
예) He practiced **hard**. / He could **hardly** breathe.

groups.title: Day 14 / 태와 시제
cards: 목적어 없이 당하는 쪽이면 be p.p., happen, occur, belong to는 수동 불가 — was occurred ✗ → occurred

당하는 쪽 + 목적어 없음 → **be p.p.** / **happen, occur, disappear, belong to, consist of** 는 수동 ✗
✗ The file **has sent** already. , ✗ The fire **was occurred** at night.
예) The file **has been sent** already. / The fire **occurred** at night.
ago, last ~, in 연도는 과거시제(수동도 was p.p.) / since는 현재완료 — has been built ten years ago ✗

**ago, last ~, in 연도** → **과거(was p.p.)** / **since + 과거 시점** → **have p.p.**
✗ He **has left** two days **ago**. , ✗ I **knew** him **since** 2015.
예) He **left** two days **ago**. / I **have known** him **since** 2015.
be p.p. 뒤 짝 전치사 — be filled with, be married to, be composed of, be known for(as)

**be filled(crowded, covered) with**, **be married to**, **be composed of**, **be known for**(이유)
✗ filled **of** / ✗ satisfied **of** / ✗ interested **at**
예) The hall **was filled with** students.

groups.title: Day 14 / 동사 뒤의 꼴
cards: 가목적어 it — found hard to sleep ✗ → found it hard to sleep(make, find, think + it + 형용사 + to 원형)

**make, find, think, consider + it + 형용사 + to 원형(that절)**
✗ I **found hard to** sleep. , ✗ The app **made that easy to** pay.
예) The app **made it easy to** pay.
order, request, insist that + 주어 + (should) 원형, 당하면 (should) be p.p. — that it to be ✗ / that it being ✗

**insist, demand, order, request, recommend + that + 주어 + (should) 원형 / (should) be p.p.**
✗ He ordered that the door **to be** locked. , ✗ She asked that he **to wait**.
예) He **ordered that** the door **(should) be locked**.
목적격보어에 시제 있는 동사 ✗ — caused him fell ✗ → to fall / enable, force, persuade + 목적어 + to 원형

**cause, enable, force, persuade, allow** + O + **to 원형** / **make, have, let** + O + **원형**
✗ caused him **fell** / ✗ forced them **leave** / ✗ had me **to wait**
예) The storm **caused** the tree **to fall**.
It takes + (사람) + 시간 + to 원형 = It takes + 시간 + for 사람 + to 원형

**It takes + (사람) + 시간 + to 원형** / **It takes + 시간 + for 사람 + to 원형**
✗ It took two hours **of me** to get there. , ✗ It took **to me** two hours.
예) **It took** me two hours **to** get there.
hope + 목적어 + to 원형 ✗ — hope you to enjoy ✗ → hope (that) you will enjoy

**hope + to 원형** / **hope + (that) + 주어 + 동사** (hope + 목적어 + to ✗)
✗ I **hope you to** enjoy it. , ✗ We **hope the rain to** stop.
예) I **hope (that) you will** enjoy it.

groups.title: Day 14 / 관용 표현
cards: to가 전치사인 표현 넓히기 — be opposed to, be committed to, when it comes to, with a view to + -ing

to가 전치사 → 뒤는 **-ing**: **look forward to -ing, object to -ing, be opposed to -ing, be committed to -ing, when it comes to -ing, with a view to -ing**
✗ They are opposed **to build** it. , ✗ when it comes **to cook**
예) They **are opposed to building** it.
cannot be too + 형용사, cannot ~ too much, cannot ~ enough — 아무리 ~해도 지나치지 않다

**cannot ~ too**(아무리 ~해도 지나치지 않다): be 뒤는 **too + 형용사**, 일반동사 뒤는 **too + 부사, too much, enough**
✗ One cannot be **too carefully**. , ✗ cannot apologize **too enough**
예) One **cannot be too careful** on icy roads. / I **cannot apologize enough**.
be worth + -ing — worth to visit ✗ / worth visited ✗ → worth visiting

**be worth + -ing** (to 원형 ✗, p.p. ✗ / 뒤에 목적어 또 ✗)
✗ worth **to visit** / ✗ worth **visited** / ✗ worth reading **it**
예) The temple **is worth visiting**.
cannot help -ing = cannot but + 원형 = have no choice but to 원형

**cannot help -ing** = **cannot (help) but + 원형** = **have no choice but to 원형**
✗ couldn't help **to laugh**, ✗ cannot but **to agree**
예) I **couldn't help laughing**. / I **couldn't but laugh**.

groups.title: Day 14 / 어순과 절
cards: how + 형용사(부사)는 한 덩어리 — how the room is large ✗ / how large is the room ✗ → how large the room is

**how + 형용사, 부사 + 주어 + 동사** (문장 안의 의문문)
✗ I know **how the room is large**. , ✗ Tell me how often **should I** come.
예) I know **how large the room is**.
절마다 본동사 하나 — 형용사, 분사만으로는 동사가 못 된다(Most guests absent ✗ → were absent)

주어 + **본동사** — 형용사, 분사 앞에 **be동사**가 있어야 절이 된다
✗ Most guests **absent** that day. , ✗ My aunt **being** a nurse.
예) Most guests **were absent** that day.
so, too + 형용사 + a + 명사 / such + a + 형용사 + 명사 어순 — so a quiet town ✗ → so quiet a town

**so, too + 형용사 + a(an) + 명사** / **such + a(an) + 형용사 + 명사**
✗ **so a quiet** town / ✗ **a too heavy** box / ✗ **such quiet a** town
예) It is **so quiet a town**(= **such a quiet town**) that ~
provided, providing (that) + 주어 + 현재시제 = ~라면 (조건절에 will ✗)

**provided(providing) (that) + 주어 + 현재시제** (조건절에 will ✗ — 주절은 will, can, may, 현재 모두 됨)
✗ provided that he **will come** / ✗ **provided if** he comes
예) I will go **provided that** he **comes** too.

groups.title: Day 14 / 수 일치와 분사
cards: be, feel, look, seem 뒤 감정 분사 — 사람이 느끼면 p.p.(felt frustrating ✗ → felt frustrated)

be, feel, look, seem + 느끼는 쪽 **p.p.** / 일으키는 쪽 **-ing**
✗ I **felt frustrating**. , ✗ The delay was **frustrated**.
예) I **felt frustrated** by the **frustrating** delay.
분사구, 관계절을 걷어 낸 진짜 주어에 수일치 — The photos taken by ~ was ✗ → were

주어 + (분사구, 관계절, 전치사구) + **동사는 주어에**
✗ **The photos** taken by my uncle **was** lost. , ✗ **The man** who owns the shops **are** rich.
예) **The photos** taken by my uncle **were** lost.
every + 기수 + 복수명사 = every + 서수 + 단수명사 — every four year ✗ → every four years

**every + 기수 + 복수명사** = **every + 서수 + 단수명사** / **every + 단수명사 + 단수동사**
✗ every four **year** / ✗ every fourth **years** / ✗ every **boys like**
예) The fair is held **every two years**(= **every second year**).
There + 동사는 뒤의 주어에 수일치 — There was several ✗ → There were several

**There + 동사 + 주어** — 동사는 **뒤의 명사**에 맞춘다
✗ There **was** several chairs. , ✗ There **has been** many changes.
예) There **were** several chairs in the room.

groups.title: Day 15 / 태와 동사 꼴
cards: 당하면 be p.p., 자동사 result, occur, remain, consist of는 수동 불가 — was resulted from ✗ → resulted from

당하는 쪽 = **be p.p.** / **result, occur, happen, remain, consist of** = 능동만
✗ The delay **was resulted** from fog. , ✗ The team **is consisted of** five people.
예) The delay **resulted from** fog. / The fair **is held** every spring.
목적어가 당하는 쪽 — get, see, hear + 목적어 + p.p., let만 be p.p. (let it forgotten ✗ → be forgotten)

**get, have, see, hear + O + p.p.** / **let + O + be p.p.**
✗ had my tooth **pulling** / ✗ let the rule **ignored**
예) I **had** my tooth **pulled**. / He **let** the rule **be ignored**.
mean -ing(~을 뜻하다), mean to(~할 작정), forget, remember -ing(한 일), regret to(유감) — means to wait ✗ → means waiting

**mean -ing** 뜻하다, **mean to** 작정하다 / **remember, forget -ing** 한 일, **to** 할 일 / **stop -ing** 멈추다
✗ Winning **means to train** daily. , ✗ I remember **to see** him once.
예) Winning **means training** daily. / I **remember seeing** him once.
눕다 lie-lay-lain(목적어 없음), 놓다 lay-laid-laid(목적어 있음) — laid in the sun ✗ → lay

**lie - lay - lain** 눕다(목적어 ✗) / **lay - laid - laid** 놓다(목적어 ○) / **lie - lied** 거짓말하다
✗ The dog **laid** by the fire. , ✗ He **lied** his coat on the chair.
예) The dog **lay** by the fire. / He **laid** his coat on the chair.

groups.title: Day 15 / 시제와 조동사
cards: since + 과거절이면 주절은 have p.p., have been -ing — is working since ✗ / ago, last ~는 과거

**since + 주어 + 과거동사** → 주절 **have p.p. , have been -ing**(It is + 기간 + since ~ 는 현재도 됨) / **ago, last ~, When** → 과거
✗ He **is teaching** here since he graduated. , ✗ We **have met** him last month.
예) He **has been teaching** here **since** he graduated.
insist, command, demand(명사) that + 주어 + (should) 원형, be p.p. — should paid ✗ / that he to go ✗

**insist, command, demand that + 주어 + (should) 원형 / (should) be p.p.**, 부정은 **not + 원형**
✗ He ordered that the gate **should closed**. , ✗ I suggested that he **to rest**.
예) The rules require that phones **not be used** in class.
should have p.p.(했어야 했다), must have p.p.(틀림없이 했다), cannot have p.p.(했을 리 없다) 가려 쓰기

**should have p.p.** 했어야 했다 / **must have p.p.** 틀림없이 했다 / **cannot have p.p.** 했을 리 없다
✗ He **must had seen** it. , ✗ (틀림없이 잤다) He **should have slept**.
예) I **should have left** earlier. / He **must have slept** well.

groups.title: Day 15 / 어순과 절
cards: find, think, make + it + 형용사 + to부정사 — find difficult to ✗ → find it difficult to

**find, think, make + it + 형용사 + (for 사람) + to 원형**
✗ I **found easy** to follow him. , ✗ She thinks it **wisely** to wait.
예) Her notes **make it simple** for us **to review**.
묻는 말 속 의문문 어순 — asked where had I been ✗ → where I had been(조동사도 주어 뒤)

**ask, wonder, depend on + 의문사 + 주어 + (조동사) + 동사**
✗ He asked **what was my name**. , ✗ Tell me **where does she live**.
예) Tell me **where she lives**. / He asked **what my name was**.
Only + 부사구, Not only, Little, Under no circumstances 문두 — 주절은 조동사 + 주어 (Only then he told ✗)

**Only + 부사(구, 절), Not only, Little** 문두 → 주절 **조동사(do, have, be) + 주어**
✗ Only later **we heard** the news. , ✗ Not only **it was** cold, but ~
예) **Only later did we hear** the news.
전치사 뒤 빠진 자리 있는 절은 what — at that we saw ✗ / from which we expected ✗ → what

**빠진 자리 있는 절 → what**(전치사 뒤에서도 what) / **빠진 자리 없는 절 → that**(전치사 바로 뒤에는 that절 ✗)
✗ proud **of that** she made / ✗ sorry **for which** I said
예) I am sorry **for what** I said. / I heard **that** she won.

groups.title: Day 15 / 수 일치와 병렬
cards: 전치사 of, in, for, without 뒤 동사는 -ing — on the verge of to close ✗ → of closing

**전치사(of, in, for, without, instead of) + -ing**, **on the verge(point) of -ing**
✗ on the verge **of to quit** / ✗ good **at to cook** / ✗ sorry **for be** late
예) He is **on the verge of quitting**.
나열은 끝까지 같은 꼴 — to call, book and sending ✗ → send / measures and sending ✗ → sends

**to A, B and C**(원형끼리), **-ing, -ing and -ing**, **동사 and 동사**(같은 꼴)
✗ to wash, peel **and cutting** the fruit / ✗ opens the box **and taking** one
예) I need **to wash**, **peel and cut** the fruit.
수식어를 건너 진짜 주어에 수일치 — The list of items … were ✗ → was

**주어 + (전치사구, 분사구, 관계절) + 동사** → 동사는 **맨 앞 주어**에
✗ The **color** of the walls **were** dull. , ✗ The **boxes** under the bed **is** empty.
예) The **taste** of these pears **differs**.
주격 관계대명사 뒤 동사는 선행사에 수일치 — students who wants ✗ → want

**선행사 + who, which, that + 동사** → 동사는 **선행사**의 수에
✗ **players** who **wants** to win / ✗ a **phone** that **work** underwater
예) I buy **pens** that **write** smoothly.

groups.title: Day 15 / 부정과 관용 표현
cards: the last person to + 원형 = 결코 ~하지 않을 사람 — not을 또 쓰지 않는다(the last man not to cheat ✗)

**the last + 명사 + to 원형** = 결코 ~하지 않을 사람(것)
✗ He is the last man **not to steal**. , ✗ the last person **to giving** up
예) A good doctor is **the last person to panic**.
alive, asleep, alike, afraid, alone은 보어 자리만 — an alive kitten ✗ → a live kitten

**alive, asleep, alike, afraid, alone** = 보어 자리만 / 명사 앞은 **living, live(동물), sleeping, similar, frightened, lonely**
✗ an **alive** fish / ✗ the **asleep** guard
예) a **living** poet, **live** animals / The poet is still **alive**.
부정문 + much less(still less, let alone) = ~은 말할 것도 없이 — 부정문 뒤 much more ✗

**부정문, much less(still less, let alone) + 같은 꼴**
✗ He has no desk, **much more** an office. , ✗ can't hum, still less **sang**
예) He has no desk, **much less** an office.
never, hardly ~ without -ing = ~하면 반드시(으레) …한다 — without to argue ✗ → without arguing

**never(cannot, hardly) ~ without + -ing** = ~하면 반드시 …한다
✗ I never shop **without to check** prices. , ✗ never eats **without not washing** his hands
예) I **never** shop **without checking** prices.
hardly, rarely, never, always는 일반동사 앞, be, 조동사 뒤 — speaks hardly ✗ → hardly speaks (not도 겹쳐 쓰지 않음)

**hardly, rarely, never, always + 일반동사** / **be, 조동사 + hardly**, not과 함께 ✗
✗ He **talks hardly** at home. , ✗ I **visit rarely** him. , ✗ I **don't hardly** know.
예) He **hardly talks** at home. / I **can hardly** wait.

memorize.subject: 영어
memorize.title: 영작 연습 Day 1
memorize.hint: 우리말 문장과 재료를 보고 머릿속이나 종이에 영어 문장을 만든 뒤 눌러서 답을 확인해요. 채점은 없어요. 재료의 동사는 원형이고 전치사와 꼴은 직접 정해요. 꼴 줄이 있으면 그 꼴로 써요 / 51문장

groups.title: Day 1 문장의 구조와 동사 유형
cards:
직원은 손님에게 환불 규정을 설명했다.
재료: The clerk / the refund policy / the customer / 동사 explain

The clerk explained the refund policy to the customer.
규칙: 4형식 불가(introduce/explain/suggest/announce + to)

회장은 월요일에 직원들에게 합병을 발표했다.
재료: The chairman / the merger / the staff / on Monday / 동사 announce

The chairman announced the merger to the staff on Monday.
규칙: 4형식 불가(introduce/explain/suggest/announce + to)

사회자는 청중에게 초청 연사를 소개했다.
재료: The host / the guest speaker / the audience / 동사 introduce

The host introduced the guest speaker to the audience.
규칙: 4형식 불가(introduce/explain/suggest/announce + to)

위원회는 다음 주 화요일에 예산 삭감안을 논의할 것이다.
재료: The committee / the proposed budget cuts / next Tuesday / 동사 discuss

The committee will discuss the proposed budget cuts next Tuesday.
규칙: 타동사에 전치사 금지

삼촌은 그 지역 병원의 간호사와 결혼했다.
재료: My uncle / a nurse from the local hospital / 동사 marry

My uncle married a nurse from the local hospital.
규칙: 타동사에 전치사 금지

작은 비행기가 거센 비를 뚫고 활주로에 다가갔다.
재료: The small plane / the runway / through heavy rain / 동사 approach

The small plane approached the runway through heavy rain.
규칙: 타동사에 전치사 금지

그녀는 그 계획이 잘될 거라고 믿지, 그렇지 않니?
재료: She / the plan / 조동사 will / 동사 believe, work
꼴: 부가의문문으로 끝맺기
